home.title: La Taverne de Jade
home.welcome1: La Taverne de Jade is a site for Genshin Impact fans. Track your progress and keep an eye on what you still need to complete. Build a to-do list for daily, weekly, monthly, or update goals, and choose which reminders to show.
home.welcome2: Wish history and the wishlist are available now. Character ascension planning is on the way.
home.welcome3After: of the same name. Reach out with suggestions or issues.
